resource_rationale: A 14-qubit complex128 statevector requires 262144 bytes for amplitudes alone; the conservative cap avoids exponential growth. A fixed structural subset bounds 10-restart p=1,2,3 optimizer work before quality is observed.
selection_rule: All hand references with n<=14, plus one random reference per available n<=14 chosen by smallest SHA-256(instance_id); selection uses no QAOA outcomes.
